messages.author: c6c81f3e042340b9
messages.subject: Re: Short tutorial on installing RApache on Mac OS X Snow Leopard
parts:
I didn't need to build R; I was able to use the R.app package, which
was already installed on my computer.

I used the commands (in the rApache directory):
./configure --with-apache2-apxs=/usr/sbin/apxs --with-R=/usr/bin/R64
sudo make
sudo make install

messages.author: 929898f938acfd69
messages.subject: Re: Short tutorial on installing RApache on Mac OS X Snow Leopard
parts:
Hi Jeff,

On OSX Snow Leopard, /etc/ld.so.conf does not exist. Not sure it is
used.

But following the instruction per doc:

bash-3.2# R CMD config --ldflags
-F/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/.. -framework R

I added the following variations each time and restarted apache with
the same error msg.

/Library/Frameworks/R.framework
/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Libraries
